Hi, I'm Joshua. I'm a data engineer based in Singapore, where I've been
since finishing my undergrad at ETH Zurich in 2022. I moved here straight
after graduating because I'd long been drawn to Southeast Asia.
Several years in, what I've come to appreciate most is the everyday life.
Singapore is small but has a lot to offer.

I work as a data engineer at Adnovum. On the side, I'm working through a
part-time MSc in Statistics at NUS.

I write here about things I'm learning, mostly in statistics and
computer science.

You can reach me at joshua [at] gloor.fyi.
